_comment: publish_mode: private | schedule | public. private (default) -> daily run uploads as Private; YOU schedule/publish manually in YouTube Studio (this also sidesteps the API audit, since manual publishing in Studio always works). schedule -> private + publishAt the next slot (auto-goes-public only after your API project passes audit). publish_slots_utc 13:00 ~ 8AM ET, 01:00 ~ 8PM ET.
